general_background.title: Dissolved sulfide supplies sulfur for precipitation
general_background.summary: Sodium sulfide supplies dissolved sulfide species for low-solubility metal sulfides in aqueous synthesis. Changing acidity changes sulfide speciation and can shift when precipitation overtakes complexation.

general_background.title: Water-compatible thiolate capping
general_background.summary: In aqueous cadmium chalcogenide growth, a mercaptocarboxylic acid can bind surface cadmium through sulfur while its carboxylate promotes water dispersibility. Changes in acidity alter the balance between metal complexation, surface binding, and dispersion.
